title: Blind Spot Monitoring and Visibility Issues
summary: This topic mixes praise for blind spot-related features with comments about visibility obstructions, alert preferences, and one unrelated rear sun blind repair item.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the blind spot monitoring or rear blind feature as a valued convenience or extra.

negative.summary: The negative review describes a warped and binding rear door roller sun blind rather than the driver-assistance blind spot system.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention blind spots from vehicle design, requests for louder or audible alerts, warning messages, and unclear feature behavior without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment evidence is limited.
